useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

title:
The Silhouette Coefficient score, is a clustering score defined as $$(b - a) / max(a, b)$$
for each sample point, where `a` is the mean intra-cluster distance and `b` is the mean nearest-cluster distance for
each sample point. See the
[sklearn reference](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/clustering.html#silhouette-coefficient) for a detailed
formulation.

This metric **requires** `modelInput` as `context`. `modelInput` is the feature matrix used in clustering and must
have the same number of samples as the `modelOutput`.

**NOTE**: The current implementation materializes the entire dataset in memory.  Thus, if the dataset is too large
to fit in memory you may run into out-of-memory errors.
name: MlSilhouetteCoefficientMetric
